resources.string: Overlay permission is required before Shortcut Hub can appear on top of other apps.
Tap your shortcut or intent again to dismiss the overlay.

Lets Shortcut Hub draw over the status bar, appear on the lock screen, and be summoned by the accessibility button, the volume-key shortcut, or an edge gesture. Shortcut Hub does not read the contents of your screen.
Draw the hub above the status bar and summon it without a launcher icon
Enable the Shortcut Hub accessibility service to use this trigger.
Shortcut Hub is off. Turn it on in the app to use it.
